newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to announce August trade balance Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to announce August trade balance Thursday.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce will announce the trade balance for August at 1500 local time/1800 GMT Thursday, a spokeswoman said.

Analysts expect a deficit of about $300 million, caused by poorer-than-expected exports because commodities producers have held onto their stocks in anticipation of a Senate vote exempting exports from taxes.
Exports in August were $4.38 billion, against expectations of $4.5 billion.
Brazil posted a $334 million trade deficit in July.
